cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Not That Subject
cards.instruction: Choose one subject you cannot let the scene reach. Redirect whenever the conversation gets close.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you open that rent letter, help me hang the curtains. I taught you to finish one job before starting another.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The landlord wants an answer today.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you've learned to read a deadline. Let's send him a picture of how well we're caring for his place.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll take one now and ask whether we're behind on rent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not with that crooked curtain in it. What did I teach you about a level line? Hold this end up; I'll keep your phone safe.
